name: BoardGovernanceHub
tagline: Terms, quorum, minutes, give/get and conflicts of interest – the whole board governance cycle in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete board governance app for nonprofits on Power Apps and Power Pages: board roster with offices, terms and term limits, rotation and succession planning, committees, meetings with attendance and automatic quorum, minutes approval with a four-eyes rule, give/get commitments with board giving participation, and annual conflict-of-interest declarations with independent review and mitigations.
features: Rotation plan by year with bylaws minimum
Conflict-of-interest declarations with mitigation and independent review
Bulk requests and reminder e-mail text
